benchmark: Not applicable to this region: the NZ benchmark places (Red Rocks, Kapiti Island, Lake Coleridge, Sumner, Godley Head, Lyttelton, Birdlings Flat, Paradise, Hump Ridge, St Kilda, Ohakune Carrot, Ninety Mile Beach) lie outside Western Victoria. Negative-benchmark behaviour holds: operator tours (Nhill Jazz Train, Halls Gap Historical Walking Tour, Budj Bim Cultural Experience) and events are rejected, a gateway whose draw is beyond it (Pomonal, Natimuk) rejected, and closed-for-refurbishment Brambuk sent to review. Note: lowest-scored kept spots have 0 page views and 0 counted sources (Princess Margaret Rose Caves, Tower Hill, Lake Surprise etc.); the stronger left-out list is every non-kept candidate with any page views, each with its written What-qualifies reason from verdicts.json.
